newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Railway bond issue oversubscribed, extended.
newsitem.headline: Indian Railway bond issue oversubscribed, extended.

text.p: The closing date for the state-run Indian Railway Finance Corp (IRFC) private placement issue of 10.5 percent tax free bonds has been extended by 15 days up to May 31, 1997, a government statement said on Thursday.
The one-billion-rupee ($28 million) bond issue, which has a right to retain over-subscription up to three billion rupees had already been "subscribed beyond the issue size," the statement said.

It said the bond, with a discount of 7.5 percent was launched on April 15, 1997 and was scheduled to close on Thursday. The date has been extended up to May 31, 1997 following requests from investors and arrangers to facilitate IRFC is a financial institution which finances development needs of state-run Indian railways. ($1 = 35.8 rupees)
